# Stouls Studio

> Interior architecture studio in Paris run by Margaux Stouls. For buyers based in the United States and Canada: apartment sourcing, design, renovation management and furnishing, for a rental investment or a pied-à-terre.

- [Buy and renovate an apartment in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/): Margaux Stouls, interior architect in Paris, finds your apartment, draws the plans, runs the renovation and furnishes it while you stay in the US or Canada. Rental investment or pied-à-terre.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from abroad | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/apartment-sourcing-paris/): Looking at apartments for sale in Paris from the US or Canada? An interior architect visits them for you and prices the renovation before you make an offer.
- [Paris apartment renovation, managed for you | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/paris-apartment-renovation/): Plans, building approvals, contractors, site visits and furnishing for your Paris apartment, run by interior architect Margaux Stouls and reported to you in English.
- [A pied-à-terre in Paris, found and renovated | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/paris-pied-a-terre/): Your own apartment in Paris, found, renovated and furnished by an interior architect while you are at home. Arrive to a finished place.
- [English-speaking interior architect in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/about/): Margaux Stouls founded Stouls Studio in Paris in 2019. She designs and manages apartment renovations, and works with owners based in North America.
- [Paris rental investment: what is allowed | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/paris-rental-investment/): Short tourist lets of a second home are all but closed in Paris. What still works, the energy-rating rules, and how an interior architect sources and builds a rental apartment for you.
- [Can Americans buy an apartment in Paris? | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/guide/buying-renovating-paris-apartment/): The purchase steps, the costs on top of the price, building approvals, energy ratings, rental rules and taxes to ask your adviser about, each with its official source.
- [Paris property glossary in plain English | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of the French words in a Paris apartment purchase and renovation: notaire, compromis, copropriété, syndic, DPE, loi Carrez, chambre de bonne, pied-à-terre.
- [What is a pied-à-terre? Meaning and pronunciation | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/glossary/pied-a-terre/): A pied-à-terre is a small second home in a city, kept for short stays. Meaning, pronunciation, plural, and what owning one in Paris involves.
- [What is a Haussmann apartment? | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/glossary/haussmann-apartment/): A Haussmann (Haussmannian) apartment is in one of the cut-stone buildings from the rebuilding of Paris, 1853 to 1870. How to recognise one, its layout, and what a renovation changes.
- [What is a chambre de bonne? | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/glossary/chambre-de-bonne/): A chambre de bonne is a former servant's room under the roof of a Paris building, usually 6 to 12 m². What it is, the legal minimum size to rent one, and what can be done with it.
- [Copropriété and syndic explained | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/glossary/copropriete-syndic/): A copropriété is a building owned in shares by its apartment owners. The syndic is the manager they appoint. What each does, what you pay, and what they decide about your renovation.
- [Paris apartment renovation cost per m² | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/paris-apartment-renovation-cost/): What Paris firms publish for renovation cost per m², from a refresh to a full premium renovation, why two apartments of the same size differ, and the costs on top of the contractor's quote.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from Canada | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/canadian-buyers-paris/): Stouls Studio's first overseas clients were Canadian. How a Canadian buyer finds, buys, renovates and furnishes a Paris apartment without being on site, in English or French.
